acceptance_criteria.statement: Guide executes ReconcileExecution for indeterminate and orphaned executing records.
Guide proves current path-Workspace/resource authorization before provider-first observation.
Guide proves trusted observation routing from AuthorizedExecutionBindingSnapshot creates no write authority.
Guide finalizes success and all closed failures under expiry and key revocation with zero write/retry.
Guide proves every safe retry reruns full current write authorization and compatibility.
Guide proves strict PostgreSQL-time expected-generation stale takeover with one winner.
Guide proves stale-terminal no-stale-persistence, exact-result takeover finalization and zero retry.
Guide proves closed current/not-stale/fenced/in-progress/terminal transition outcomes and owner/generation/lease fencing.
Guide proves provider-commit-before-Knora-persist recovery without duplicate.
Guide proves executing-before-provider-receipt not-found takeover/retry with same identity.
Guide proves unavailable/timeout/malformed/not-found remain distinct HTTP 202 non-terminal results.
Guide proves only found success/closed failure terminalize with exact public mapping.
Guide proves independent SQLite persistence and complete secret-safe audit reconstruction.
Guide binds exact-candidate static-registry/no-plugin/no-vendor evidence to both SHAs.

design_decisions.decision: Ten required Test Cases cover the ticket's ten approved case families without merging distinct authority, crash or concurrency oracles.
Every expected matrix is independently sourced and imports no production result, enum, serializer or mapper.

Independent ordered sentinels prove the authorized sequence path-Workspace/resource observation authorization -> trusted snapshot routing -> provider observation, and prove every observation denial has zero provider-observation calls.

A valid observation-routing snapshot is held constant while current write authorities independently fail; every retry/admission/dispatch/create_ticket/provider-effect seam is counted and must remain zero.
Separate lock barriers capture fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time for takeover, observation and finalization; host clocks are non-authoritative.
Public reconciliation rows have closed complete key sets, lifecycle/outcome values and HTTP statuses; retry denial remains separate from provider outcome.
Candidate evaluation binds guide revision/digest, exact subject SHA, environment revision, ten case records and append-only human approval.
Guide preparation adds no implementation authority; external APPROVE plus explicit human lock are mandatory.

invariants: All ten Test Cases are required and trace to the externally approved ticket v4.
Every authorized provider observation occurs only after current path-Workspace/resource observation authorization and trusted snapshot routing, in that exact order.
Every observation-authorization failure has zero trusted-routing and provider-observation calls.
No expired owner records an observation or final outcome.
Terminal provider truth never becomes retry and observation authority never becomes write authority.
No field, digest, identity or provenance from AuthorizedExecutionBindingSnapshot is accepted as write authority.
Provider not-found is non-terminal; every write retry retains one logical identity/fingerprint and reruns all fresh current write checks.
Expected identities and matrices are independent from the application result under test.
SQLite provider truth and PostgreSQL workflow/audit state are restarted and evidenced independently.
Release evidence contains digests/counters only and excludes raw provider/admission/key/credential/authority material.
Final code review is not part of this guide and remains deferred until #75 through #79 complete.
out_of_scope: Implementation, human guide lock or manual acceptance execution before guide external APPROVE.
Dynamic plugin/discovery/provider registration or vendor-specific integration.
Issue #79 integrated release harness and final M4 code review.
A distributed transaction or provider rollback/cancellation protocol.

test_cases.statement: Authorize current path Workspace/resource, resolve trusted observation routing, then reconcile SQLite success/all closed failures under current-owner, current-foreign and expired leases; separately run every observation-authorization denial.
test_cases.oracle: Every authorized trace is path-Workspace/resource authorization succeeds -> trusted snapshot routing -> provider observation; every authorization failure has zero resolver/provider-observation/write/effect calls; lease behavior retains one exact terminalization and zero retry.

test_cases.statement: Reconcile NoAdmission provider-not-found before/after strict expiry, race contenders and authorize first write only through fresh current write checks independent of the observation snapshot.
test_cases.oracle: Not-found remains distinct HTTP 202; one post-expiry winner reruns m4r1, write Workspace/resource, ExecutionAuthorizer and compatibility checks, creates one admission and dispatches once; snapshot fields/provenance satisfy no write check and losers make zero calls.

test_cases.statement: Race AdmissionOutstanding not-found recovery replay with delayed original dispatch.
test_cases.oracle: One takeover, no new/replaced admission, byte-identical persisted envelope, same ID/fingerprint and at most one provider effect across restart.

test_cases.statement: Finalize all terminal outcomes under expiry/key revocation; deny observation; then retain valid observation routing while independently denying every current write-authority seam and attempting every retry/write seam.
test_cases.oracle: Expiry/revocation terminalizes with zero write; observation denial is pre-routing/pre-provider with zero observation calls; valid snapshot may route observation but cannot authorize retry, and admission/dispatch/create_ticket/lookup/provider-ledger/effect counts all remain zero until every fresh current write check passes; mismatch remains stale/new approval.

test_cases.statement: Use independent PostgreSQL barriers and skewed host clocks to race current/stale/changed-generation/foreign/terminal callers.
test_cases.oracle: Fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time decides; one generation winner; typed dispositions only; no stale/loser observation or finalization write.

test_cases.statement: Inject unavailable, timeout, malformed/unknown, not-found, success and all closed failures at application/HTTP seams and compare independent complete matrices.
test_cases.oracle: Indeterminate/not-found remain distinct 202; success is 200; closed failures are 502/TOOL_PROVIDER_FAILURE with exact rejection; complete key allowlists and no private leakage.

test_cases.statement: Trigger both crash windows, independently restart Knora/SQLite, keep observation routing valid while denying current write authority for no-receipt, then separately authorize same-identity retry.
test_cases.oracle: Provider-committed outcome terminalizes through authorized observation order and one stale takeover with zero retry/duplicate; valid snapshot with denied write authority yields zero admission/dispatch/create_ticket/effect; only all fresh checks permit same-ID retry and repeated calls converge.

test_cases.statement: Reconstruct all recovery timelines from append-only PostgreSQL audit and compare independent SQLite truth after restart.
test_cases.oracle: Complete ordered authority/binding/generation/lease/observation/retry/fence/terminal provenance, independently authoritative provider ledger and no forbidden private/secret fields.

test_cases.statement: Run exact focused/full/Ruff/Compose/clean-Alembic lifecycle commands on the candidate and inspect clean status.
test_cases.oracle: All exits zero, exact totals recorded, M1-M3 and M4.1-M4.3 regressions green, Alembic head and clean worktree.

test_cases.statement: Run production registry/composition probes and exact source-base-to-candidate dependency/entry-point/architecture scope manifest.
test_cases.oracle: Static immutable ticket_lookup/create_ticket registry, generic provider seam, fake/SQLite adapters only and no plugin/discovery/registration/marketplace/vendor scope; both SHAs bound.

command_projections.statement: Recreate PostgreSQL and run Alembic upgrade/current before focused and full suites; run downgrade/re-upgrade/current after full suite.
From backend run exact focused command for reconciliation workflow/PostgreSQL/provider/HTTP/release harness.
From backend run full test and eval suite serially; from root run Ruff and Compose config.
Generate exact candidate release evidence plus source-base/candidate registry/dependency/entry-point/architecture manifest.

required_evidence.statement: Guide file and structured Test Case artifact digests plus exact ticket review and prior-guide-review provenance.

Per-authorized-call ordered path-Workspace/resource authorization -> trusted snapshot routing -> provider observation traces; per-observation-denial zero provider-observation sentinels; valid-snapshot/current-write-denial matrices proving every retry/admission/dispatch/create_ticket/lookup/provider-ledger/effect count is zero and snapshot provenance is absent from write-authorizer inputs; plus PostgreSQL clock/lease/generation rows.
Independent application/HTTP/authority/audit matrices with recursive key comparisons and forbidden-field failures.
Independent SQLite ledger/effect snapshots across both crash windows and restarts with logical identity/admission lineage.
Exact candidate SHA, source base, registry/composition scope manifest and focused/full/migration/static verification exits/totals.
One append-only Evaluation record per run with all ten case results and explicit human acceptance approval only after observed PASSED.

prior_findings.required_change: Require and evidence current path-Workspace/resource observation authorization succeeds before trusted snapshot routing and provider observation, plus zero provider-observation calls for every authorization failure.
prior_findings.closure_projection: TC-01 steps/oracles and GEV-02 now require the exact successful-path sequence and per-denial zero observation sentinels.

prior_findings.required_change: Keep the observation snapshot valid while current write authority independently fails; attempt every retry/write seam and prove zero dispatch, create_ticket and provider effects, with no snapshot provenance accepted as write authority.
prior_findings.closure_projection: TC-02, TC-04, TC-07 and GEV-02 now require the differential valid-snapshot/write-denial matrix and complete zero-count/write-input exclusion evidence.
